talents.e: Grants {10|20}% more Mana from Life Tap.
Raises hit chance by {1|5}% and cuts all threat you generate by {4|20}%.
Cuts Corruption cast time by {0.4|2} sec and raises its damage by {2|10}%.
Increases the range of your Affliction spells by {10|20}%.
After killing a non-trivial target hit by Drain Soul, gain {50|100}% Mana regen for 10 sec, with {50|100}% continuing while casting.
Raises damage, health, or Mana drained by Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana by {7|20}%.
Increases Bane of Agony damage by {5|10}%.
Gives Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack a {23|70}% chance to keep cast time when you take damage.
Your next curse hits harder for thirty seconds, with a short cooldown.
Raises crit damage bonus of Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain spells, Siphon Life, and Wrack by {33|100}%.
Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by {1|5}%.
Gives Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack a {2|4}% chance to make your next Shadow Bolt instant.
Slows the target's movement by thirty percent for twelve seconds.
Steals eleven health from the target every three seconds for thirty seconds.
Raises damage or health drained by Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack by {4|12}% per other Affliction effect on target, max {12|36}%.
Increases damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by {2|10}%.
Inflicts Shadow damage every second and amplifies your other Shadow damage over time.
Raises Health Funnel transfer by {20|40}%, cuts its cost {15|30}%, its threat {50|100}%, and allows use regardless of demon health.
Increases Imp Firebolt damage by {10|30}% and Fire Shield effect by {10|30}%.
Increases total Stamina by {3|15}%.
Increases all damage from your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by {2|10}%.
Increases Demon Skin and Demon Armor effectiveness by {15|30}%.
Increases Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering effectiveness by {10|30}%.
Raises max health and Mana of your demons by {5|15}% and your own max Mana by {5|15}%.
Heals your pet for {8|15}% of spell damage dealt; Life Tap gives your demon {50|100}% of the Mana you gain.
Increases Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss by {10|30}%, and Seduction and Lesser Invisibility duration by {10|30}%.
Sacrifices your demon for a two-hour buff that depends on its type.
Cuts Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter summon cast time by {2|4} sec and Mana cost by {20|40}%.
Cuts Soul Fire cooldown {45|90}%; hitting enemies under 35% health adds {3|6}% damage, and Soul Fire gets {20|40}% faster cast and no Shard cost for 10 sec.
Your next demon summon casts much faster and costs half the Mana.
Searing Pain: {17|50}% less threat and a 10 sec brand; your pet's next {2|6} attacks deal 65% to 68% (+7.8%) of your higher Fire or Shadow Spell Power.
Increases Tainted Blood, Devour Magic healing, and Paranoia detection by {10|30}%, and cuts Spell Lock cooldown by {2|6} sec.
Thirty percent of your damage taken goes to your demon, and both deal more damage.
Raises your and your demon's spell damage by up to {33|100}% of your level while a demon is summoned.
Gives {2|10}% bonuses: Imp Fire damage, {2|10}% Voidwalker physical damage reduction, {2|10}% Succubus/Incubus Shadow damage, {2|10}% Felhunter magic damage reduction.
Summoning a different demon no longer cancels your Demonic Sacrifice effect.
Increases the range of your Destruction spells by {10|20}%.
Shadow Bolt crits make the target take {4|20}% more Shadow damage from your attacks for 12 sec.
Cuts Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate cast time by {0.1|0.5} sec and Soul Fire cast time by {0.4|2} sec.
Reduces all damage taken by {2|10}%.
Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by {3|10}%.
Raises Immolate initial damage by {10|50}%; Conflagrate has a {20|100}% chance to daze, slowing target 50% for 5 sec.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by {20|100}%.
Instant Shadow blast; killing a non-trivial target within eight seconds grants a Soul Shard.
Gives Destruction spells a {23|70}% chance to keep cast time when you take damage.
Increases Searing Pain crit chance by {3|10}% and all Destruction spell damage by {3|10}%.
Consumes your Immolate on an afflicted target to deal Fire damage.
Soul Fire has a {13|26}% chance to stun for 3 sec; Rain of Fire and Hellfire have a {13|26}% chance to stun targets they damage.
Curses target so fifteen percent of your damage to others also hits them for five minutes.
Increases Conflagrate critical strike chance by {8|25}%.
Conflagrate adds {2|10}% Shadow damage and Shadowburn adds {2|10}% Fire damage for 20 sec; Conflagrate triggers it {20|100}% of the time and Shadowburn {20|100}% of the time.
Fire damage spell that deals extra damage when the target has Immolate.
